content: Official UEFA 2026/27 Nations League regulations define 14 league-phase groups: four groups of four in Leagues A, B and C, and League D with two groups of three or four; League A has quarter-finals then semi-finals, third-place match and final; promotion/relegation play-offs are A/B, B/C and C/D. UEFA Articles 12-19 specify league scoring, tie-breakers, cross-group comparison, interim/final rankings, two-leg play-offs, League A quarter-final draws and single-leg finals.
